purpose: Acquire and no-return screen one initial equity-incentive plan disclosure count-and-freshness factor for the fixed three-local-session A-share protocol without participant identities, plan economics, credentials, prices, or returns.

pre_row_contract_correction.reason: Correct the initial all-literals assumption before source access: require 草案 and at least one of the frozen ordinary plan-type literals 限制性股票激励计划, 股票期权激励计划, or 股权激励计划.

provider_contract.recursive_bisection: After fetching only page one, bisect an inclusive date range into two non-overlapping inclusive calendar ranges before requesting later pages when advertised pages exceed 80. A single calendar date above 80 pages is fatal.
provider_contract.transport_attempt_policy: Sequential requests. A page may be attempted at most three times only for timeout, connection, HTTP 429/5xx, or JSON-decoding failure. Schema, identity, pagination, count, or content failures are never retried or skipped.

identity_and_schema_policy.unsupported_complete_code_policy: Exclude and count BSE, STAR, funds, bonds, and every other complete non-holding code. They never enter source or factor coverage denominators.
identity_and_schema_policy.announcement_timestamp: announcementTime must be a complete non-boolean integer Unix epoch in milliseconds; convert from UTC to Asia/Shanghai, use the local calendar date, and require that date to lie inside the inclusive leaf partition
identity_and_schema_policy.announcement_id: Unicode NFKC, trim leading and trailing whitespace, require a nonempty scalar string, use only in memory for identity, and discard before publication
identity_and_schema_policy.announcement_title: Unicode NFKC, trim leading and trailing whitespace, collapse internal Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space, require a nonempty scalar string without angle-bracket markup, use only in memory for classification, and discard before publication
identity_and_schema_policy.duplicate_policy: Any duplicate source identity inside or across accepted partitions is fatal; never silently deduplicate or use page position as identity.
identity_and_schema_policy.extra_record_fields: Allowed but ignored and forbidden from persistence. A missing required record field is fatal.
identity_and_schema_policy.pagination_consistency: Every page in one leaf partition must report the same nonnegative integer totalAnnouncement; requested pages must be exactly 1 through ceil(totalAnnouncement/30) once each; each non-final page must contain 30 object rows, the final page must contain the exact remainder, and concatenated received rows must equal totalAnnouncement exactly.
identity_and_schema_policy.empty_leaf_policy: A leaf with totalAnnouncement zero must have an empty announcements list. A whole frozen Q1 acceptance window with zero source rows is fatal.

title_classification.normalization: Unicode NFKC, trim, collapse internal Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space, reject angle-bracket markup, then apply case-sensitive Chinese literal containment
title_classification.classification_rule: A row qualifies only when every all-required literal appears, at least one required plan-type literal appears, and no excluded literal appears after normalization.
title_classification.nonmatching_policy: Exclude and count. Never add a synonym, inspect the body, or revise the title map after any provider title is observed.

event_and_factor_definition.source_event_measure: initial_equity_incentive_plan_disclosure_count = number of globally unique qualifying announcement identities for one instrument and announcement_date
event_and_factor_definition.multiple_event_dates: Use only the latest announcement_date whose strict-next-session effective date is on or before the target session. A later effective event supersedes an older event.
event_and_factor_definition.valid_factor: finite and strictly positive; calendar age is an integer from 1 through 3 inclusive under the strict-next-session rule
event_and_factor_definition.invalid_policy: Exclude and count without clipping, filling, title substitution, winsorizing, taking an absolute value, changing sign, adding grant economics, summing superseded dates, or extending age.
event_and_factor_definition.absent_event_policy: missing; never zero nonalignment or a favorable score

point_in_time_policy.signal_source_date: Asia/Shanghai calendar date derived from announcementTime
point_in_time_policy.conservative_availability: first local trading session strictly after announcement_date regardless of the observed intraday timestamp
point_in_time_policy.weekend_or_holiday_announcement: Map to the first local trading session strictly after the calendar announcement date; age remains calendar days and can expire after a long closure.
point_in_time_policy.entry_if_later_admitted: next local session open after signal-close ranking
point_in_time_policy.revision_policy: The public announcement index is treated as a current historical index without immutable response versions. Duplicate identities, title changes, removals, pagination changes, or count changes reject the source; announcement bodies and URLs are not requested or used.
point_in_time_policy.residual_limitation: The current public index can add, remove, recategorize, or retitle historical announcements. Waiting to the next session prevents same-date trading but cannot reconstruct announcements absent from the current index.

acceptance_protocol.initial_partitioning: nine non-overlapping calendar months across the three fixed Q1 windows; recursive bisection follows the provider contract before later pages
acceptance_protocol.candidate_cross_section_definition: one local session after strict-next-session availability and the three-calendar-day latest-event rule, point-in-time holding-universe filtering, at least six distinct instruments, and at least two distinct finite factor values
required_checks: the mechanism audit, contract, holding universe, calendar, quarterly quality, accepted price-basis context, frontier, latest terminal record, and both execution policies match before network access

only the frozen public endpoint, category, fields, dates, page ceiling, retry policy, title literals, and exact identity are used; no user Token, credential, cookie, proxy, retail session, body, participant, plan economics, price, or return is accessed
all nine initial months and every recursive leaf reconcile stable totalAnnouncement metadata and received rows exactly, with no skipped or duplicate page
every required transport field is complete and structurally valid; complete unsupported-board records are excluded and counted, while malformed or duplicate identities abort
every source identity is globally unique before title classification and aggregation, and every published instrument/announcement_date event key is unique afterward
point-in-time holding-universe filtering and strict-next-session calendar mapping occur before sample variation checks
the latest-event age-weighted factor formula reproduces exactly in memory, remains finite and positive, and never uses an event older than three calendar days
each Q1 window and combined samples pass the frozen source-row, qualifying-event, cross-section, name, and value-variation thresholds
the published frame contains only four normalized columns; title, announcement id, identity hash, name, body, plan economics, price, return, credential, cookie, proxy, and retail session are absent
acceptance_protocol.failed_acceptance_policy: Write one terminal no-return source rejection, delete the hidden partial snapshot, publish no Parquet, and stop without another title, identity, date, field, aggregation, formula, direction, age, threshold, full sync, comparison, price, return, score, selection, sizing, or order.
acceptance_protocol.one_shot_policy: The exact acceptance may publish at most one success or rejection manifest. Once a provider request is issued, a schema/content/gate failure consumes the attempt. Every clone must reject a second attempt from the tracked result before loading this contract or issuing a request.

full_snapshot_contract_after_acceptance_.recursive_bisection: same count-complete leaf rule and eighty-page ceiling as acceptance
full_snapshot_contract_after_acceptance_.failure_policy: Delete the complete temporary snapshot, publish no final partition, write one terminal no-return source record, and stop without retry or price access.

capacity_contract_after_full_source_only.quality_gate: ROE at least 5 percent, positive net profit, positive revenue YoY, and positive profit YoY with maximum age 550 calendar days
capacity_contract_after_full_source_only.capacity_failure_policy: Stop the exact mechanism permanently without loading comparisons, prices, or returns and without changing title classification, identity, age, samples, universe, quality, listing, name, value, cohort, or year gates.

uniqueness_contract_after_capacity_only.semantic_gate: Every sparse neighbor receives an explicit economic and source comparison before price access. Generic announcement count/freshness is not accepted as independence; the compensation-alignment mechanism must remain distinct from ownership and management-trading events.
uniqueness_contract_after_capacity_only.statistical_gate_for_sparse_neighbor: When at least 100 eligible pairwise sessions contain at least 6 pairwise names, require absolute median daily Spearman rank correlation below 0.8. Otherwise report overlap and descriptive correlation without treating sparse absence as uniqueness proof.
uniqueness_contract_after_capacity_only.dense_gate: Each dense confounder must provide at least 100 eligible pairwise sessions with at least 50 names and absolute median daily Spearman rank correlation below 0.8.
uniqueness_contract_after_capacity_only.anti_cherry_pick: The comparison catalog, overlap policy, thresholds, title map, identity, formula, direction, age, universe, and quality rule cannot change after any provider row, title, or factor value is observed.
